calibration: Produced at RadixArk with NVIDIA Model Optimizer (ModelOpt) following what the card calls a mixed NVFP4 W4A4 recipe; hf_quant_config.json in the repository carries the scheme. The calibration set is not stated on the card.
notes: RadixArk's FP4-lm_head variant: the sibling nvfp4-bf16-lmhead in this directory is RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-BF16-LMHead, a different quantization of the same model with the head left in BF16, and the two are not interchangeable. Sizes read from the Hugging Face file listing at the pinned revision: 22 files, 21,945,295,265 bytes, of which 21,921,697,280 bytes are the three safetensors shards. The MiaAI-Lab DGX Spark recipe selects this repository for QUANT=nvfp4-fp4; the pangoleen DFlash2 recipe serves it as its default target beside the maurienne-ai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-NVFP4-RTNcal drafter (1.55 GB, revision bd7a934213c47a9e7ef69eef36bb3325f47fd1f1), which is a speculative draft model passed as an engine argument rather than a quantization of this model.
